essence: This mantra has eleven syllables and Jamadagni as its sage
The heart-nyāsa is formed by yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ namo hṛdayāya namaḥ
The head-tuft nyāsa is formed by yauṃ nauṃ mauṃ nama aiṃ vaṣaṭ śikhāyai vaṣaṭ
After uttering śriyai netrāya vauṣaṭ, one should place it in the eyes
All meditation and worship should be performed as in the Mahālakṣmī procedure
